newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian govt okays 90 mln lita support for bank.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian govt okays 90 mln lita support for bank.

text.p: The Lithuanian government said on Thursday it had approved a plan to restructure and support the country's third largest bank, state-run State Commercial Bank.
A plan to issue 90 million litas of state securities to maintain the bank's liquidity was passed at Wednesday's cabinet meeting, a government spokesman told Reuters.
The plan was approved by parliament last month.
It emerged in July that State Commercial Bank was staggering toward insolvency under the weight of bad loans, just as Lithuania was in the process of recovering from a banking crisis.
The bank's losses in the first half of the year totalled 104 million litas while its assets tumbled in the same period from 733 million litas to 353 million litas.
In a bid to avert a fresh crisis in the sector, the government said in July it would rescue the bank and then privatise it once its problems were sorted out.
The government also ordered all state departments to transfer their accounts to the troubled bank, a move which sparked protest from the private banking community.
